module-5-customer-follow-up-capstone.label: Module 5 Customer Follow-Up Capstone
module-5-customer-follow-up-capstone.summary: Build a production-ready follow-up report by carrying one SQL query through status, contactability, location/date, pattern, sorting, and row-limit requirements.

practice-capstone-contactability.title: Practice: Build a contactable customer slice
practice-capstone-contactability.prompt: Return `full_name`, `email`, and `status` from `customers`, in that order. Keep only active customers with a recorded email, and exclude test records.
practice-capstone-contactability.hint: Combine the exact status requirement with the two contactability checks.

help.concept: Several independent cleanup requirements can be combined so every required condition must be satisfied.
help.hint_1: The email must be present rather than missing.
help.hint_2: Keep real records rather than test records.

practice-capstone-contactability.starterCode:
-- Build the contactable active-customer slice.
SELECT full_name, email, status
FROM customers
WHERE
practice-capstone-contactability.solutionCode:
SELECT full_name, email, status
FROM customers
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `customers` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `full_name`, `email`, `status`.

practice-capstone-city-window.title: Practice: Combine a city set and date window
practice-capstone-city-window.prompt: Return `full_name`, `city`, and `signup_date` from `customers`, in that order. Keep customers from Chicago or Miami who signed up from `2026-01-10` through `2026-02-05`, including both boundary dates.
practice-capstone-city-window.hint: Combine one allowed-city requirement with one inclusive signup-date window.

help.concept: An allowed value set and an inclusive range can be combined without changing the selected result columns.
help.hint_2: The beginning and ending dates both count.

practice-capstone-city-window.starterCode:
-- Combine the location and date requirements.
SELECT full_name, city, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE
practice-capstone-city-window.solutionCode:
SELECT full_name, city, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE city IN ('Chicago', 'Miami')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05';

sourceChecks.message: Use the `customers` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `full_name`, `city`, `signup_date`.

practice-capstone-ranked-outreach.title: Practice: Filter, rank, and limit
practice-capstone-ranked-outreach.prompt: Return `full_name` and `signup_date` from `customers`, in that order. Keep names containing the letter `a`, show the newest signup dates first, use customer name A to Z to break date ties, and return only the first three rows.
practice-capstone-ranked-outreach.hint: Finish the filter before building the two-level ranking, then reduce the ranked result to three rows.

help.concept: A ranked subset needs its complete ordering before the final row count is applied.
help.hint_1: Signup date controls the main ranking.
help.hint_2: Customer name only decides the order of rows that share the same signup date.

practice-capstone-ranked-outreach.starterCode:
-- Build the filtered ranked outreach slice.
SELECT full_name, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE
practice-capstone-ranked-outreach.solutionCode:
SELECT full_name, signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE full_name LIKE '%a%'
ORDER BY signup_date DESC, full_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `customers` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `full_name`, `signup_date`.

cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.title: Build the eligible-status slice
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.prompt: Lifecycle operations wants a follow-up candidate list. Return `full_name`, `city`, and `status` from `customers`, in that order. Keep customers whose status is either `active` or `draft`.
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.hint: Keep the selected columns and change the status filter so either approved status can qualify.

help.concept: A status-set requirement keeps a row when its status matches either approved value.
help.hint_1: Keep the selected columns and table unchanged.
help.hint_2: Both active and draft rows should be eligible.

cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.starterCode:
-- The starter keeps only active customers.
-- Expand the filter so active and draft customers are both eligible.
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status = 'active';
cp-1-start-follow-up-slice.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft');

sourceChecks.message: Use the `customers` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `full_name`, `city`, `status`.

cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.title: Keep real contactable customers
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.prompt: The outreach system can only use real records with an email address. Carry the approved status slice forward. Return `full_name`, `email`, `city`, and `status`, in that order. Keep only rows with a recorded email and exclude test records.
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.hint: Preserve the approved status rule, then add the two new contactability requirements.

help.concept: Cumulative SQL work preserves approved logic and adds only the new business rules.
help.hint_1: Do not replace the status-set requirement from the previous milestone.
help.hint_2: The dataset uses the test flag to distinguish real and test records.

cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft');
cp-2-keep-real-contactable-customers.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0;

cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.title: Add location and signup-date focus
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.prompt: Regional operations wants only Chicago or Seattle customers who signed up from `2026-01-10` through `2026-02-05`, including both boundary dates. Carry the approved query forward. Return `full_name`, `email`, `city`, `status`, and `signup_date`, in that order.
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.hint: Preserve the earlier rules, then add one two-city requirement and one inclusive signup-date window.

help.concept: This milestone combines an exact set of allowed cities with an inclusive lower-and-upper date boundary.
help.hint_1: Keep the approved status, contactability, and real-record requirements.
help.hint_2: Both dates at the edges of the requested window must remain eligible.

cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0;
cp-3-add-city-and-date-focus.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05';

sourceChecks.message: Use the `customers` table in the FROM clause.

cp-4-finish-capstone-report.title: Deliver the ranked final handoff
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.prompt: For the final handoff, keep only names containing the letter `a`. Sort the approved records by `signup_date` from earliest to latest. When signup dates tie, sort `full_name` from A to Z. Return only the first five rows and preserve every earlier requirement.
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.hint: Add the final name-pattern rule, establish both ranking priorities, then trim the completed ranking to five rows.

help.concept: The final report filters first, creates a deterministic primary-and-secondary ranking, and only then keeps the requested number of rows.
help.hint_1: Keep every approved filter from milestone 3.
help.hint_2: Signup date is the primary ranking; customer name only breaks ties.

cp-4-finish-capstone-report.starterCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05';
cp-4-finish-capstone-report.solutionCode:
SELECT
  full_name,
  email,
  city,
  status,
  signup_date
FROM customers
WHERE status IN ('active', 'draft')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND is_test = 0
  AND city IN ('Chicago', 'Seattle')
  AND signup_date BETWEEN '2026-01-10' AND '2026-02-05'
  AND full_name LIKE '%a%'
ORDER BY signup_date ASC, full_name ASC
LIMIT 5;
